description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity class 'AnimationLoading' that demonstrates loading animator objects from XML resources and animating shapes (balls) within a custom View 'MyAnimationView'. It includes methods for setting up animations, creating shape objects, and rendering animated graphics on the screen.

classes.name: AnimationLoading
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating loading Animator objects from XML and animating shape objects.

classes.name: MyAnimationView
classes.description: Custom View class that manages shape objects (balls), sets up animations via animator XML resources, and handles drawing and animation updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity UI, adds custom animation view, and sets up button to start animations.

methods.name: createAnimation
methods.description: Sets up multiple Animator objects (ObjectAnimator, ValueAnimator, AnimatorSet) with XML resources and combines them into an AnimatorSet for coordinated animation.

methods.name: createBall
methods.description: Creates a ShapeHolder object with an oval shape drawable at specified position.

methods.name: addBall
methods.description: Creates and adds a ball ShapeHolder with a specified color to the list.

methods.name: addBall
methods.description: Creates and adds a ball ShapeHolder with a randomly generated color.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws all shape objects (balls) onto the canvas at their current positions.

methods.name: onAnimationUpdate
methods.description: Callback for value updates during animation, updating shape position and triggering redraw.
